Toughpower GT Series
The fully modular Toughpower GT series is designed to deliver 80 PLUS Gold efficiency and is compatible with ATX 3.1 standards. Its native
PCIe 12V-2x6 (12+4 pin) modular interface efficiently powers PCIe 12+4 pin graphics cards. Backed by an extensive 5-year warranty, the
Toughpower GT series meets the needs of value-oriented users seeking a new power supply with reliable performance.
ATX 3.1 Ready
Toughpower GT series is fully compatible with ATX 3.1 specifications which supports up to 200% power excursion, reaches 60% efficiency at low
load and complies with required power supply timing standards.

PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready
Toughpower GT series comes with a PCIe 12V-2x6 connector to offer powerful and stable performance allowing the PSU to natively run
next-generation GPUs.
The wattage marked on the PCIe 12+4-pin cable connector represents the recommended wattage (Ref. Intel design guideline). The bundled PCIe Gen
5.1 (12+4pin) cable connector of the Toughpower GT 1000W can deliver up to 600W for PCIe 12+4pin graphics cards.
Note:
1. Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage, and many
other factors.
2. Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the PCIe 12+4pin cable.
12+4pin Connector
Ultra Quiet 120mm Hydraulic Bearing Fan with Smart Zero Fan
Featuring an 120mm Hydraulic Bearing Fan to keep friction at really low level. Designed with our Smart Zero Fan to adjust the fan speed and
minimizes undesired noise.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail & High-Class Technologies
Powerful single +12V rail can properly deliver the power you need for the best compatibility. The use of LLC and DC to DC circuit design
provides very stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.
